summary_en: One-year ruling for 2008 only: in Singapore the blessing and imposition of ashes of Ash Wednesday may be anticipated to the afternoon of the vigil (the preceding Tuesday), with the obligation of fast and abstinence transferred to that vigil day.
excerpt: Singapore: Conceditur ut anno 2008 tantum ritus benedicendi et imponendi cineres feria quarta Cinerum habendus in vigiliam istius diei horis postmeridianis transferri possit, obligatione ieiunii autem et abstinentiae translata in diem vigiliae feriae quartae (20 nov. 2007, Prot. N. 1105/07/L).

summary_en: One-year ruling for 2009 only: because of the Pauline Year, on 25 January 2009, which falls on the Third Sunday in Ordinary Time, one Mass of the Conversion of St Paul the Apostle may be celebrated in each church (with the second reading and the Creed taken from the Sunday).
excerpt: Prot. N. 268/08/L — DECRETUM quo facultas peculiaris de celebratione Conversionis Sancti Pauli apostoli in anno iubilare, quo bismillesimum anniversarium ortus eius recolitur, datur. [...] conceditur, ut, indole extraordinaria occasionis perpensa, venturo die 25 ianuarii anno 2009, quae Dominica III « per annum » occurret, in singulis ecclesiis una tantum Missa iuxta formularium In conversione Sancti Pauli, apostoli, ut in Missali Romano exstat, celebrari possit.

summary_en: St Pius of Pietrelcina, priest, is inserted in the General Roman Calendar on 23 September as an obligatory memorial (Calendarium Romanum Generale p. 113; Proprium de Sanctis p. 835; texts in the Supplementum p. 1276). The change is printed in the list of variations of the 2008 reimpressio emendata of the Missale Romanum (editio typica tertia); no protocol or date is printed for the calendar items, and the decree cited for the reimpressio (Prot. N. 652/08/L, 8 June 2008) does not itself mention them.
excerpt: Calendarium Romanum Generale — p. 113: Ad diem 23: additur: « S. Pii de Pietrelcina, presbyteri – Memoria ».

summary_en: The word « martyris » is removed from the entry for day 29 on p. 112 of the Calendarium Romanum Generale of the Missale Romanum; the page is not named by month, but p. 113 is September and p. 116 December, so p. 112 is August and the entry is the Passion of St John the Baptist (29 August) — an inference, hence flagged. The change is printed in the list of variations of the 2008 reimpressio emendata of the Missale Romanum (editio typica tertia); no protocol or date is printed for the calendar items, and the decree cited for the reimpressio (Prot. N. 652/08/L, 8 June 2008) does not itself mention them.
excerpt: Calendarium Romanum Generale — p. 112: Ad diem 29: tollitur « martyris ».

summary_en: St Juan Diego Cuauhtlatoatzin is inserted in the General Roman Calendar on 9 December (Calendarium Romanum Generale p. 116; Proprium de Sanctis p. 881; texts in the Supplementum p. 1276); no rank is printed. This implements the insertion already decreed in 2002 (Prot. n. 1828/02/L, recorded from Notitiae 2004). The change is printed in the list of variations of the 2008 reimpressio emendata of the Missale Romanum (editio typica tertia); no protocol or date is printed for the calendar items, and the decree cited for the reimpressio (Prot. N. 652/08/L, 8 June 2008) does not itself mention them.
excerpt: Calendarium Romanum Generale — p. 116: Ad diem 9: additur: « S. Ioannis Didaci Cuauhtlatoatzin ».

summary_en: Our Lady of Guadalupe is inserted in the General Roman Calendar on 12 December (Calendarium Romanum Generale p. 116; Proprium de Sanctis p. 881; texts in the Supplementum p. 1277); no rank is printed. This implements the insertion already decreed in 2002 (Prot. n. 1622/02/L, recorded from Notitiae 2004). The change is printed in the list of variations of the 2008 reimpressio emendata of the Missale Romanum (editio typica tertia); no protocol or date is printed for the calendar items, and the decree cited for the reimpressio (Prot. N. 652/08/L, 8 June 2008) does not itself mention them.
excerpt: Calendarium Romanum Generale — p. 116: Ad diem 12: additur: « B. Mariae Virginis de Guadalupe ».

summary_en: In the Proprium de Sanctis of the Missale Romanum (p. 869) the title « religiosae » is added after « S. Elisabeth Hungariae » for 17 November, aligning the Missal heading with the Calendarium; an editorial harmonisation rather than a new act. The change is printed in the list of variations of the 2008 reimpressio emendata of the Missale Romanum (editio typica tertia); no protocol or date is printed for the calendar items, and the decree cited for the reimpressio (Prot. N. 652/08/L, 8 June 2008) does not itself mention them.
excerpt: p. 869: Ad diem 17 novembris post titulum « S. Elisabeth Hungariae », additur « religiosae ».
